name: backend
description: AstraFlare NASA FIRMS Ingestion Backend with PostgreSQL and GeoJSON

scripts.db:shell: docker exec -it astraflare_postgres psql -U postgres -d astraflare_db
scripts.db:stats: docker exec astraflare_postgres psql -U postgres -d astraflare_db -c 'SELECT count(*) AS total_thermal_anomalies FROM thermal_anomalies;' -c 'SELECT count(*) AS total_predictions FROM prediction_analyses;'
